events.title: 아스널 finally reach the FA Cup final after beating 리버풀 1-0 in the FA Cup semi-final third replay at Highfield Road . 리버풀 agree a fee of £300,000 for 체스터 시티 striker 이언 러시 , 18.

리버풀 clinch the league title in their penultimate league game of the season by beating 애스턴 빌라 4–1 at Anfield . The result is rendered academic by 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–0 defeat to 리즈 유나이티드 . 입스위치 타운 lose the unbeaten League run that they have maintained for over five months against 맨체스터 시티, but remain third. 레스터 시티 beat Orient to clinch the Second Division title, and 버밍엄 시티 join them in promotion by drawing 3–3 with 노츠 카운티 . In the Third Division, Kevin Drinkell fires three of 그림즈비 타운 's four without reply at home to 셰필드 유나이티드, which sees the Mariners crowned third-tier champions.
Trevor Brooking scores the winning goal as Second Division 웨스트햄 유나이티드 triumph 1–0 over holders 아스널 in the FA Cup final .
아스널 lose 5–4 in a penalty shoot-out to 발렌시아 after a 0–0 draw in the European Cup Winners' Cup Final .

More than two weeks after the planned final day of the season, the First Division fixtures are completed when 아스널 lose 5–0 to 미들즈브러. The result leaves 입스위치 타운 one point ahead of the Gunners in third place.
노팅엄 포리스트 retain the European Cup by beating 함부르크 1–0 in the final in Madrid . John Robertson scores the only goal in the first half.
